title: Sozlama kontraktini kengaytirish
why: Loyiha papkasining yagona, saqlanadigan va eski sozlamalarga mos kontraktini yaratish.
work: Core Settings ichida discovery sozlamasini default policy bilan ifodalash; OS home resolution platform qatlamida qoladi. JSON preferences uchun additive serde default va kerak bo‘lsa versioned migratsiya. Rust/TS Bootstrap DTO, mavjud test fixture va save oqimini moslashtirish. Faqat parent directory policy; UI va watcher keyingi bosqichlarda.
criteria: Eski language/theme JSON yangi maydonlarsiz yuklanadi va ikkala qiymat saqlanadi.
Default policy macOS va Windows uchun foydalanuvchining home katalogiga Devforge segmentini qo‘shadi; disk ildizidagi /Devforge yaratilmaydi.
Custom absolute yo‘l yoki boshlang‘ich ~ qo‘llab-quvvatlanadi; relative, bo‘sh, NUL/control character va faylga ishora qiladigan yo‘l actionable error beradi.
Til/theme o‘zgarishi discovery yo‘lini, discovery o‘zgarishi til/theme qiymatini yo‘qotmaydi; stale full-settings yozuvlari uchun regression testi bor.
Default katalogni yaratish bir martalik initialization yoki explicit create bilan bajariladi; mavjud katalog va uning tarkibi o‘zgarmaydi.
Custom path mavjud bo‘lmasa Save uni jim yaratmaydi: Create folder amali yoki boshqa yo‘l tanlash talab etiladi.
Saqlash/validation xatosida oldingi saqlangan yo‘l saqlanadi; app startup settings xatosini muvaffaqiyat deb yashirmaydi.
evidence: Legacy JSON/reopen, home resolver (har target), invalid path va saved-value preservation test natijalari; old/new settings payload namunasi (secrets yo‘q).

title: Chegaralangan skanerni yaratish
why: Runtime tanlanmagan bo‘lsa ham Laravel loyihasini xavfsiz aniqlash.
work: Tauri’dan mustaqil shallow scanner va typed candidate DTO yaratiladi. Mavjud inspect()/manifest limitlarini qayta ishlatish yoki read-only tekshiruv chegarasini ajratish. Only direct child directories, maqsadli composer/package/public index metadata. Root scan natijasi complete/partial/unavailable/cancelled holatlarini farqlaydi. Chunk, cancellation, entry cap va per-entry errors.
criteria: Laravel fixture artisan/public/index.php/composer.json belgilariga ko‘ra topiladi; mos kelmagan katalog successful Laravel deb ko‘rsatilmaydi.
Bir daraja skanerlanadi: nested app, vendor va node_modules tarkibi rekursiv o‘qilmaydi; dot-directory va DevForge staging/data kataloglari kandidat bo‘lmaydi.
PHP/Node paketlari o‘rnatilmagan fixture ham needs_runtime candidate sifatida chiqadi; hech qanday download boshlanmaydi.
Qisman ko‘chirilgan loyiha keyingi skanda to‘liq bo‘lgach topiladi; invalid yoki oversize manifest boshqa loyihalarning natijasini to‘sib qo‘ymaydi.
Scan script, composer/npm, artisan, Git hook va .env amallarini bajarmaydi; byte/sentinel tekshiruvi project fayllari o‘zgarmaganini isbotlaydi.
Symlink/junction/reparse child boshlang‘ich scope’da avtomatik follow qilinmaydi; sabab ko‘rsatiladi va explicit Import saqlanadi.
Root unavailable yoki entry cap holatida partial/unavailable qaytadi; bu holat barcha eski loyihalar missing degan natijaga aylantirilmaydi.
Tekshiruv uchun fake clock/temporary tree ishlatilib cancellation va 10,000 direct-child cap aniq tasdiqlanadi; cap natijasida truncation ko‘rsatiladi.
evidence: Golden, no-runtime, malformed, incomplete-copy, unreadable-child, no-recursion/no-side-effects, cancellation va cap fixture natijalari.

title: Registrni xavfsiz birlashtirish
why: Topilgan loyihalarni mavjud ma’lumotlar bilan dublikatsiyasiz va tiklanadigan tarzda birlashtirish.
paths: crates/serving/src/site.rs (only if scoped reuse is necessary)
work: ProjectStore’da additive discovery ledger/candidates/suppression metadata va source association; registration Project invariants saqlangan holda bajariladi. Compatible verified installed runtime topilsa register + HTTP site configure; topilmasa candidate snapshot’da qoladi. Registry va sites.json yozuvlari cross-file transaction emas: idempotent pending/recovery holati kerak. Root generation, optimistic revisions va operation/session guard ishlatiladi.
criteria: Bir xil canonical/fizik loyiha manual import, create wizard va discovery orqali uchrasa bitta active Project ID bilan qoladi.
Compatible installed runtime mavjud bo‘lganda har qanday qayta skan registrda aynan bitta project/site yaratadi; yarim yozuv keyingi reconcile’da tuzatiladi.
Runtime yetishmasa candidate UI contract’da qoladi; register qilish uchun soxta package ID ishlatilmaydi va xizmat ishga tushmaydi.
Mavjud PHP/Node selections, custom domain, favorite, DB/cache/mail bindings, secrets, worktree ownership va project revisions skaner tomonidan almashtirilmaydi.
Forget discovery suppression yozadi; qayta skan/restart loyihani qaytarmaydi; Restore/Import suppression’ni explicit olib tashlaydi.
Complete skan yo‘qolgan papkani missing deb belgilaydi; failed/partial scan hech qanday ommaviy missing holatini qo‘llamaydi va DB/project fayllari o‘chmaydi.
Same-filesystem stable identity bilan ishonchli rename project ID va bog‘lanishlarni saqlaydi; running session bo‘lsa relocation pending bo‘ladi, guarded stop/apply yo‘li talab etiladi.
Windows File ID/volume identity mavjud bo‘lmasa yoki identity noaniq bo‘lsa avtomatik birlashtirish qilinmaydi: relocation review candidate, old record saqlanadi.
Root A dan B ga o‘tganda old association detached bo‘ladi, manual entries qoladi va A generation natijalari B ni o‘zgartira olmaydi.
Yangi domen shop.devforge.test formatida; Unicode/invalid nomga stable valid slug taklif qilinadi; domain conflict mavjud saytni egallamaydi va rename custom domenni o‘zgartirmaydi.
evidence: Legacy project DB additive migration/reopen, dual-source dedup, suppression/restart, rename/ambiguous move, pending-site recovery, stale generation va binding preservation assertions.

title: Kuzatuvchi hayotini ulash
why: Ilova ochiq paytda fayl tizimi o‘zgarishlarini yo‘qotmasdan va UI’ni bloklamasdan aniqlash.
work: notify backend yoki mos mavjud dependency bilan cancellable DiscoveryService. Native notification faqat invalidation signal; authoritative shallow scan qayta reconcile qiladi. Root parent va direct children uchun nonrecursive watches, faqat inspection marker fayllari kerak bo‘lsa maqsadli public watcher; full tree watch yo‘q. Initial/focus/manual/periodic reconciliation, bounded coalescing queue, single-flight scan va generation token. Workspace Mutex ichida filesystem walk yoki watcher callback yo‘q.
criteria: Ilova startida UI sahifasi ochilishini kutmasdan saved root scan boshlanadi; close-to-tray holatida davom etadi, Quit’da to‘liq tugaydi.
Root ichida mkdir/copy/rename/delete va direct-child manifest atomic replace natijalari restart yoki Refresh bosmasdan snapshot’da chiqadi.
Watcher event’lari 500ms quiet debounce va 2s max-latency invalidation bilan birlashtiriladi; bitta active scan va bounded dirty flag/queue mavjud.
Root/child watch error yoki overflow 30s periodic shallow fallback va ko‘rinadigan degraded status beradi; app focus va manual rescan recovery qiladi.
100-child local fixture event’i UI pollingni qo‘shib 5s ichida ko‘rinadi; fallback fixture 35s ichida konvergensiya qiladi; bular proposed acceptance budget, o‘lchov qayd etiladi.
Root switch vaqtida eski watch’lar va pending timer bekor qilinadi; late generation natija persist qilinmaydi; 50 switch stress’da handle/thread soni baseline’ga qaytadi.
Root delete/recreate yoki disconnect/reconnect parent watch/fallback orqali tiklanadi; permission-denied degraded holati eski rows’ni o‘chirmaydi.
10,000 ta event burst bounded xotira bilan bitta final authoritative natijaga konvergensiya qiladi; user project scripts/caches bo‘yicha recursive event storm kuzatilmaydi.
evidence: Native watch smoke timing, forced failure/fallback, burst/switch/quit lifecycle assertions; backend thread/queue bound hisobotlari; dependency versiyasi va mosligi primary source bilan qayd etiladi.

title: Settings oqimini yetkazish
why: Foydalanuvchi papkani tanlashi va aniqlash natijasini boshqarishi uchun mavjud UI’ni kengaytirish.
work: Mavjud Settings uslubida Loyiha papkasi: label+path draft, native picker, explicit Save, Reset to default, Create folder kerak bo‘lsa, Scan now. Status/count/last scan/retry. Projects ro‘yxatida candidate va registered statuslarini farqlash; existing Prepare/Start/Import oqimlarini qayta ishlatish. New Project wizard parent default saved root’dan, foydalanuvchi o‘zgartira oladi. Backend DTO tor typed commands; UI’dan filesystemga to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri ruxsat qo‘shilmaydi.
criteria: Text input va native folder picker bir xil draft’ni yangilaydi; Cancel picker current/saved qiymatni o‘zgartirmaydi; Save keyin relaunch’da yo‘l qaytadi.
Save explicit: har keystroke active watcher’ni o‘zgartirmaydi; invalid input inline xato, pending holatda double-submit bloklanadi; failed Save eski active root’ni saqlaydi.
Default qiymat ~/Devforge, Windows’da resolved native path ko‘rsatiladi; Reset default oldingi user folder contentini ko‘chirmaydi yoki o‘chirmaydi.
Scan now single-flight ishlaydi; scanning/empty/success/degraded/error/unavailable holatlar ko‘rinadi, error’ning retry amali bor.
Candidate needs-runtime/missing/conflict/ignored/relocation-pending holatlari oddiy stopped/ready bilan aralashtirilmaydi; Start faqat haqiqiy registered ready loyiha uchun ishlaydi.
Forget qilingan entry uchun Restore oqimi va root o‘zgargandagi detached loyihalar tushuntiriladi; existing manual Import tashqaridagi loyihalarni qo‘shadi.
New Project default parent saved root’dan olinadi; publish/setup staging katalogi tayyor bo‘lguncha discovery uni register qilmaydi; create/discovery race bitta project yaratadi.
Russian, Uzbek, English catalogs label/error/status/a11y matnlar bilan teng; dark/light/system va minimum desktop window’da long Unicode path horizontal overflow bermaydi.
Keyboard Tab, visible focus, picker cancel/return focus va aria-live status ishlaydi; loyiha nomlari/yo‘llari tarjima qilinmaydi.
evidence: React interaction/async error tests, locale lint, incumbent va updated Settings screenshot’lari; ui-taste/uizze-ui scoped implementation, web-design-guidelines affected-source review. Native system picker interaction phase 6’da alohida tekshiriladi.

title: Native platformalarni tekshirish
why: OS watcher, path identity, Tauri IPC va real serving’ni har targetda bajarib isbotlash.
work: M12/M8 native harness pattern’ini qayta ishlatib alohida fixtures/data dirs/ports. Matrix macOS ARM64, macOS Intel, Windows x64. Actual watcher events orqali default/custom/add/rename/delete/resume, actual WebView Settings input-save-relaunch, Prepare/Start real HTTP. Native picker selection/cancel return-focus alohida actual system-dialog evidence; mock tanlov bu gate o‘rnini bosmaydi. Native lane authorization mavjud bo‘lsa CI; push/run scope bo‘lmasa aynan tested source artifact bilan existing authorized remote route, bo‘lmasa ochiq gate.
criteria: macOS ARM64’da built Tauri app, watcher, saved path, startup/relaunch va discovered Laravel HTTP fixture actual ishlaydi; OS/arch/source hash hisobotda bor.
macOS Intel’da ayni final source hash bilan native backend va WebView checks bajariladi; ARM64 natijasi Intel o‘rniga yozilmaydi.
Windows x64’da ayni final source hash bilan WebView2, watcher, backslash/drive case, case-only rename, Cyrillic/spaces/non-ASCII parent va long path tests bajariladi.
Har targetda real folder picker selection/cancel tekshiriladi yoki alohida NOT VERIFIED gate yoziladi; native dialogga xizmat qiladigan IPC mock bilan pass belgilanmaydi.
No-runtime candidate, installed-runtime register, duplicate/manual import, Forget+Restore, corrupt manifest recovery, root permission/missing va switch-during-scan stsenariylari native hisobotda bor.
Actual watcher event/overflow fallback va tray/quit lifecycle tekshiriladi; App e2e feature production HTTP control endpointini ochmaydi.
Fixture HTTP selected PHP orqali 200 beradi; existing .devforge.test/.localhost-port serving modeli saqlanadi; hosts/CA native fixture faqat owned isolated muhitda.
Reports/screenshots tested commit + uncommitted artifact digest/source archive bilan bog‘lanadi; zip report provenance tekshiriladi va secrets/raw .env yuklanmaydi.
Target yoki dialog automation mavjud bo‘lmasa no green completion: bajarilgan mustaqil checks va ochiq native gates aniq saqlanadi; cross-compile runtime deb ko‘rsatilmaydi.
commands: cargo run --release -p devforge-workspace --example native_workspace --features test-support -- discovery-native discovery-fixture
evidence: Har target uchun alohida JSON assertions, source hash, native Settings/Projects screenshots, picker evidence, HTTP response, watcher/fallback timings va cleanup result; skipped/cancelled lane pass emas.

title: Polish & Harden
why: Oxirgi source barcha kontrakt, foydalanish va platforma mezonlariga mosligini yakuniy tekshirish.
work: Bounded UX/copy/a11y pass, input/IPC/diff review, isolated rename/permission/storm regression, release-mode performance measurement va adjacent import/create/prepare/worktree/service smoke. Documentation/code/evidence reconciliation; faqat affected knowledge. Old unrelated tests failures baseline bilan alohida ko‘rsatiladi, yangi regression yopiladi. Audit source native tekshirilgan hashga teng bo‘lishini tekshiradi; keyingi code o‘zgarsa tegishli native gate qayta bajariladi.
criteria: Final workspace fmt/clippy/tests va frontend typecheck/test/build/locale checks exit 0; relevant baseline failures bo‘lsa ular aniq dalil bilan ochiq va complete claim berilmaydi.

100 local sibling candidate fixture cold scan 3s ichida, UI confirmation native event’dan 5s ichida, fallback 35s ichida; release build/hardware/workload bilan o‘lchanadi yoki asosli revised budget review’da qayd etiladi.

Normal local idle’da periodic root reconciliation 30s dan tez emas, unchanged candidates reimport qilinmaydi, child dependency subtree o‘qilmaydi; resource trend 50 root switch/10k event test’da bound ichida.

Minimum supported desktop size va 3 locale x light/dark (system representative) states screenshot/interaction bilan tekshiriladi; scoped axe’da yangi finding 0, native picker focus alohida tekshiriladi.
Existing manual import/Create/Prepare, custom runtime/domain, worktree cleanup, service binding va persistent DB ma’lumotlari uchun tegishli regression stsenariylari o‘tadi.
Discovery avtomatik process/download/DB/.env/system DNS/CA mutation boshlamasligi sentinel/owned-state checks bilan tasdiqlanadi; Start/Prepare mavjud explicit oqimida qoladi.
Yakuniy knowledge’da confirmed requirement, proposed/changed design, actual implementation va har platformaning verified/unverified chegarasi ajratiladi; strict validator 0 error/0 warning.
Final diff’da task debug prints, session TODO/FIXME, dead imports yoki aloqasiz source o‘zgarishi yo‘q; publish/deploy/commit/push userning yangi ko‘rsatmasisiz bajarilmaydi.
Original ROADMAP criteria yakuniy source/evidence bilan qayta audit qilinadi; native yoki system-dialog gate ochiq bo‘lsa feature fully verified deb yopilmaydi.
evidence: Final check summaries/exit codes, native matrix final-source table, measured budgets, scoped diff/a11y review, knowledge validation va open gates; product completion faqat actual evidence bilan.
